description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹淨零建築與建築產業ESG趨勢，並從建築全生命週期「使用碳排（OC）」與「蘊含碳排（EC）」的觀點，培育學生具備建築產業淨零轉型的專業知識與評估診斷能力，進而探討從近零邁向淨零的減碳設計策略。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces net-zero buildings and ESG trends in the construction industry. It cultivates students with professional knowledge and expertise in the net-zero transformation of the construction industry from the perspectives of " Operational Carbon (OC)" and " Embodied Carbon (EC)" throughout the building life cycle. This explores carbon reduction design strategies from near-zero to net zero.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠定義「淨零建築」的意涵，瞭解其對於建築產業發產趨勢之影響及重要性。
targets.describe_en: Define the meaning of "net zero building" and understand its impact and importance on the development trend of the construction industry.

targets.describe_ch: 理解淨零建築設計之概念與執行策略。
targets.describe_en: Comprehend the concepts and implementation strategies of net-zero building design.

targets.describe_ch: 學習建築能效與蘊含碳排計算之實務，並進行操作評估。
targets.describe_en: Learn how to practice energy efficiency and embodied carbon emissions calculations and conduct operational evaluations.
